messages:
Maya: Hey team — intake for AcmeHealth onboarding. Quick summary: 12 seats, primary contact Sarah (Dir of ML). Customer wants Redwood Private (VPC) + SSO. Contract runs through 2027 -> renewal risk low, but they need SOC2-ready audit trail and a 6-week delivery target.

Ben: Confirming billing contact is finance@acmehealth.com, contract ID ACME-2026-08. Sales expects first invoice after staging sign-off.

Kai: For Private we need their VPC peering details and a staging subnet. Also: do we have sample prompt corpus + expected sequence lengths? That affects kernel selection.

Sarah (AcmeHealth): Hi all — yes, I can share a redacted dataset for eval. We need SSO via SAML, logs forwarded to our SIEM, and can provide a staging VPC by EOD Wednesday. 6-week target is aggressive but possible if infra is ready.

Priya: Proposed engagement phases (high level):
```
Phase 1 (week 0-2): infra + access (VPC peering, SAML, keys), staging provisioning
Phase 2 (week 2-4): model validation, sample prompt sweep, latency/cost baseline
Phase 3 (week 4-6): runbooks, enablement training, go/no-go + cutover plan
```
Success metrics we should agree on: p95 inference latency <= 300ms for 2k tokens, throughput >= 50 rps sustained on Dedicated pool, and quality regression delta < 3% on eval prompts.

Evan: Heads-up: custom quantization requested by their infra team could increase tuning time. Need to flag for cost estimate — will draft numbers by Thursday.

Maya: Action items I put on calendar invite (sent):
- Sarah: share redacted prompt corpus + staging VPC info (owner: Sarah) — due Wed EOD
- Kai: prep staging AMI and infra checklist (owner: Kai) — due Thu
- Priya: create eval prompt set + baseline tests (owner: Priya) — due Fri
- Evan: cost/ops estimate for quantization + storage (owner: Evan) — due Thu
- Ben: confirm invoice milestone language with finance (owner: Ben) — due Fri

Ben: I'll own weekly cadence with the customer — recommend 30m sync Tuesdays. I'll send recurring invite. :calendar: 

Kai: Quick question on access: will engineers get service account tokens or will we use SSO/SAML for staging access? Prefer service account for infra scripts.

Sarah (AcmeHealth): We can provision a service account for Redwood engineers scoped to staging only. I'll add the IAM policies.

OnboardBot: New project created: CS-ACME-2415. Auto-assign: Maya, Ben, Priya.

Priya: For evals — please include a few long-context examples (5k tokens) so we can validate KV caching and memory behavior. Also share any redaction rules early.

Evan: Risk note: compliance wants audit logs forwarded and 90-day log retention. Confirming Redwood logging integration supported in Private deploy — Ops to verify.

Maya: Good catch. I'll add an audit log checklist item. Also, renewal note: sales marked this as low risk but medium delivery risk due to integrations. We'll track on the risk board under CS-ACME-2415.

Sarah (AcmeHealth): Thanks all. Prefer first sync Thu 10am PT if that works for the team.

Maya: Thu 10am PT works. I'll share agenda: 1) infra handoff, 2) eval dataset walkthrough, 3) success metric alignment, 4) next steps. Please add items to the doc if you have them.

Ben: Added weekly cadence and internal handoffs to the agenda.

Kai: I'll post the infra checklist into the doc before the meeting.

Maya: Perfect. Closing here for now — follow-ups in the doc/todo. :white_check_mark:
